title: UistateSetParams
description: Params for uistate.set. The sidebar carries its WIDTH and nothing else: which panel a tab shows, and whether its rail is collapsed, are facts about the TAB and live on its layout row (ADR-x7cvh8e1). The decoder refuses the old window-wide `collapsed`/`activeViewId` pair, so this schema must refuse them too — a contract that allowed them would promise a shape no build accepts.

width.description: The panel's width in CSS pixels; the store clamps it to the declared bounds, and 0 means "no width was recorded".
